title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78, looks to start trading Nov. 19, sources say
description: Anthropic has set a price range of $70 to $78 per share for 825 million shares in its upcoming IPO, according to people familiar with the matter. The company plans to price on Nov. 18 and begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT" on Nov. 19. The offering could raise as much as $64.4 billion.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York's AI safety law takes effect
description: New York's RAISE Act is entering enforcement, with the state opening a registration portal for large frontier AI developers. Companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic must register by January 1, 2027, bringing them under new state-level safety oversight.

title: Microsoft is giving Claude the keys to UK Copilot tenants by default
description: Microsoft will enable access to Anthropic's Claude models by default for UK Microsoft 365 Copilot tenants starting next month. UK administrators have until December 9 to change the setting if they want to opt out, raising data-handling questions for enterprise customers.

title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
description: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, including a Business Hub where companies can claim and manage their listings. Eligible U.S. ecommerce and online service businesses can also deploy Business Agents that interact with customers inside ChatGPT.

title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
description: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, an AI travel agent startup founded by Sonder founder Francis Davidson. Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The acquisition adds travel-planning expertise as OpenAI expands agentic commerce features in ChatGPT.

title: Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence, custom widgets, and more in our November Pixel Drop
description: Google's November Pixel Drop brings Gemini Intelligence to the Pixel 10 lineup along with custom widgets and other features. Google also introduced the Pixel Tag tracker, available from November 11 at $29.99 for one or $99.99 for a four-pack.

title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
description: Hugging Face's Irene Solaiman warned that cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter access restrictions. The warning comes as inference provider Fireworks disclosed that attackers accessed some customers' model weights, datasets and billing information.

title: Mercor raises $750M at $20B valuation to take AI agent evaluation to enterprises
description: AI training-data company Mercor raised $750 million at a $20 billion valuation. The company plans to use the funding to expand its AI agent evaluation offerings to enterprise customers deploying agents in production.

title: Stanford's century-long AI study admits it's already out of date
description: Stanford's One Hundred Year Study on AI (AI100) released its third report. The panel acknowledges the pace of AI progress means its findings will quickly date, and describes current AI governance as fragmented.
